summary: All 24 labelled normal-chow ARC RNA-seq genes agreed in direction between the author figures and the registered knockout-versus-control result. Of the 21 genes the authors called significant on both diets, only Fabp7 and Arntl passed the registered normal-chow BH threshold of 0.05. The proposal records this selected-gene comparison and leaves full verification open. [Author supplement](https://www.jci.org/articles/view/140424/sd/1)
openIssues: The public sources searched lacked the full normal-chow DESeq2 table. Exact author effects, per-gene P and FDR values, and the cause of the 19 differing significance calls remain unassessed. The 24 genes fall below the 30-pair concordance minimum.
The separate qPCR panel showed decreases for Nr1d1 and Nr1d2, while both registered whole-gene estimates were positive. The paper supplies no sample-level crosswalk between assays.
The evidence files are present locally. This checkout’s Git exclude rule covers the continued-sources directory.
